correctness.rationale: The exact block-sum multiplication coefficient r_X(i)c_Y(j) yields a necessary and sufficient joint-profile criterion by summation over all blocks. With two rows it gives disjoint separated/balanced cases; column profile fibers in the balanced case have exactly a full block or an even split into two complementary blocks. The orbit group construction explicitly realizes every resulting partition. Weighted Bell enumeration and the exponential formula give all m. The standalone verifier directly tests all 4140 partitions for 2x4 and all 115975 for 2x5 (at m=5 via separately implemented profile lemma), checks formulas for m=1..5 and subgroup-orbit certificates. Finite tests supplement the proof; no claim of formal verification.

value.rationale: Rectangular bands are a natural first family after left/right-zero semigroups in the new semigroup-Schur invariant. The motivating paper notes only product lower bounds B(n)B(m) for these bands and small exceptional non-product examples (5 vs 4 at m=2, 13 vs 10 at m=3). This result completely classifies and enumerates the two-row family for arbitrary m, shows all extra non-product rings are nonetheless automorphic, and supplies a closed EGF and exact count beyond tabulated sizes. It resolves a motivated structural and enumerative gap rather than computing a contrived slice.
